answer_1.quote: We evaluate our system on three well-recognized datasets for multi-turn task-oriented dialogue system: MultiWOZ 2.1 (MWOZ), Stanford Multi-Domain (SMD), and CamRest... The goal of an end-to-end task-oriented dialogue system model is to learn a mapping that takes the dialogue context C_t and knowledge database K as input and generates an information response R_t.
answer_1.outputs: system responses generated for task-oriented dialogues

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, BLEU and Entity F1 are used as the evaluation metrics.
